name: deribit-dvol
notes: Structural gates over one `dvol` pull of source deribit-btc-dvol or deribit-eth-dvol (Deribit's DVOL implied-volatility index, 1-minute, through restwindow). DVOL is in annualised percentage points, so a decimal fraction (0.35) or a basis-point count would be a unit change: the level rules warn outside [5, 500]. High above low is not in the rule vocabulary. Run: python -m dskit.onboarding validate --suite configs/suite-deribit-dvol.json --snapshot <snapshot-vid> --root <store root>.

rules.notes: An empty pull is a broken pull (wrong currency, a start in the future, an API change).
One row per minute; a duplicate means the window clipping failed.
Epoch MILLISECONDS from 2024-01-01 (the shipped start) to 2100. A backstop: the connector drops a row outside its window, so this trips only on a row the pack let through.
The effective instant the connector writes beside the raw ts.
Implied vol in percentage points cannot be negative; 1000 is far past any reading.
Outside [5, 500] annualised percentage points is not a level DVOL has read: a unit change or a bad row. Read it before modelling.
The span stops a minute before now (lag 60), so a row dated after acquisition is a defect.
